user.title: NWI Mesh
user.description: Connect Home Assistant to a Meshtastic community mesh. Defaults are set for NWI Mesh (nwimesh.net); point it at any mesh's HopWatch or MQTT server.

data.name: Name
data.hopwatch_url: HopWatch URL (network stats; leave blank to disable)
data.host: MQTT server (live messages; leave blank to disable)

data_description.hopwatch_url: Public aggregate stats from HopWatch. Default: https://hopwatch.nwimesh.net
data_description.host: Any Meshtastic MQTT server. Default is the public NWI Mesh server.
data_description.root_topic: Same as the MQTT root topic on your node, e.g. msh/US/IN/NWI
data_description.channels: Channel name and key as shown in the Meshtastic app. AQ== is the default public key. Only these channels are decoded; direct messages are never readable.
data_description.history: How many recent messages the Last message sensor keeps for the dashboard.
data_description.broker_name: Which broker HopWatch reports for the Broker sensor (NWIMesh).

error.nothing_enabled: Enable at least one of HopWatch or MQTT.
error.bad_channels: Channels must look like LongFast=AQ== (key is base64, 1, 16 or 32 bytes).
error.cannot_reach_hopwatch: Couldn't read /api/v1/stats from that HopWatch URL.
error.cannot_connect_mqtt: Couldn't connect to that MQTT server with these settings.

abort.already_configured: This mesh is already set up.
